observation.evaluation:
Correctness: PARTIALLY_CORRECT
Safety: CAUTION
Issues: Single lateral view with superimposed ribs cannot reliably assign the rib deformity to right versus left; the visible “L” marker indicates projection/left side, not the side of the deformity; no PA/AP or prior imaging is provided to confirm the proposed right-sided assignment.
Suggestion: Confirm laterality with a PA/AP chest radiograph or prior imaging; if only the lateral view is available, report “rib deformity” without assigning right versus left.
